title: Evaluation questions — messy, formal and tricky, paired with message ids
description: What the pipeline is scored on. `expected_message_ids` is the set of messages any correct answer may cite (the same set semantics as the change definition: one canonical gold is not the target). A tricky question cites nothing and must be refused.

expected_message_ids.description: Any message stating the expected value. Empty only when must_abstain is true.

expected_value.description: Optional: a substring the answer must contain (e.g. '2,4 M€').
